basic_profile.bio: ModMaster72 is a passionate gamer and modding enthusiast based in Seattle, Washington. With a knack for creativity and technology, they spend their days developing mods for popular games like Skyrim and sharing their work with the community. Working as a freelance graphic designer allows them the flexibility to explore their hobbies extensively. They are usually online during late evenings and weekends. In a long-term relationship, they enjoy spending their downtime playing co-op games with their partner. Dislikes include toxicity in online communities and poorly optimized mods.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: ModMaster72 has a strong background in digital arts, having studied graphic design at a local community college. They are self-taught in coding and game modding, learning through online tutorials and forums. Their expertise extends to creating texture packs and scripting NPC behavior in games. They actively keep up with the latest modding tools and trends.
